subject: Startups
title: What Makes a Product Viral
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Makes a Product Viral.

hook.text: A viral product isn't one people talk about. It's one where using it automatically invites new users.

buildup.text: The viral coefficient measures how many new users each existing user brings in. Above 1.0, growth is exponential.

discovery.text: Truly viral products embed sharing into the use case. You can't use them without pulling others in.

twist.text: Most 'viral' products aren't actually viral. They're just popular. True virality means growth without spending.

climax.text: WhatsApp grew to 450 million users with almost no marketing. The act of messaging someone was the invitation.

punchline.text: Viral means the product spreads by being used.

quiz.question: What viral coefficient means exponential growth?
